    About Moolah

    Last updated 2 October 2026

    Moolah teaches real money skills through short daily lessons, for kids and adults alike. You learn by doing. Lessons come first, then practice trading with pretend money, so mistakes cost nothing.

    Moo the bull is your guide along the way.

    Where we are

    Moolah is an early preview. Lessons and practice trading are the focus today. Real investing is planned for the future. It will only launch once the right licences or partners are in place, and for kids it will need a parent's approval.

    What we stand for

    • Learning should feel good. Streak freezes cover missed days, there are no guilt-trip notifications, and leaderboards rank lesson points, never money.
    • Kids' safety comes before growth.
    • Plain language and no hype about investing.

    Who is behind Moolah

    Moolah, no ABN (this site is a demo), Sydney NSW, Australia.

    Questions or feedback? Visit our Contact page.

    For Parents and Safety

    Last updated 2 October 2026

    If your child uses Moolah, you should know exactly what it does and does not do. This page explains it in plain terms.

    How Moolah is built

    • Practice money only. Everything your child trades today is pretend. No real money is held or moved, and no real trade can be placed.
    • No chat or messaging. Children cannot talk to each other or to strangers inside Moolah.
    • Private leaderboards. Leaderboards show a username and progress only. They never show real names, photos, location or money.
    • No pressure tactics. Streak freezes cover missed days, there are no guilt-based notifications, and leaderboards rank lesson points, never how much money someone has. Lessons use a limited number of "Bull Power" per session, and practice questions never use it up.
    • Parent approval for real investing. Real investing is not available. When it is, a child's account will need a parent's approval and verification.

    What we collect from children

    In the current preview, what a child types into the sign-up screen stays in the browser on their own device and is not sent to us. We encourage using a nickname instead of a real name and never adding a photo. Our Privacy Policy explains the details.

    Tips for families

    • Sit with your child for their first session.
    • Use a nickname rather than a full name.
    • Do not enter real passwords or codes in any practice or preview screen.
    • Talk about the difference between practice money and real money.

    If something goes wrong

    Tell us at hello@moolah.example. For worries about online safety more broadly, the eSafety Commissioner at esafety.gov.au can help. If a child is in immediate danger, call 000.

    Help and FAQ

    Last updated 2 October 2026

    Is any real money involved?

    No. All trading in Moolah uses practice money. Real Money Mode is a design preview. It cannot place a trade and does not connect to a broker, bank or payment provider.

    Is this financial advice?

    No. Moolah gives general education only. It does not consider your goals, finances or needs, and you should not buy or sell anything because of it. A licensed financial adviser can give personal advice. See our Disclaimer.

    Are the stock prices real?

    By default, prices are simulated. If you choose to enter your own free Finnhub key, real percentage movements for the day are applied to the practice prices. The dollar prices shown are still practice values, not live quotes.

    What information does Moolah collect?

    The preview has no accounts on our servers. A name, username or email typed into the sign-up screen is saved in your browser on your own device and is not sent to us. See the Privacy Policy.

    How do I delete my data?

    Your data sits in your browser. Clear the site data for this website in your browser settings and it is gone. A reset button inside the app is planned.

    Should I enter my real password or code in Real Money Mode?

    No. Those screens only show how verification will look later. They are not connected to any account. Please never enter real credentials anywhere in the preview.

    Is my API key safe?

    Moolah does not contain a key of its own. If you enter your own free Finnhub key, it is stored only in your browser and sent only to Finnhub to fetch prices. You can disconnect it at any time to remove it.

    Is Moolah safe for kids?

    It is built with kids in mind: no chat, no real money and no guilt-based notifications. Read For Parents and Safety.

    Will there be ads?

    Not at the moment. A future free version may show light ads. They would be clearly labelled, suitable for kids and would never promote financial products to children.

    How do I report a problem?

    Email hello@moolah.example. We reply within 2 business days. For formal complaints see Complaints.

    Complaints

    Last updated 2 October 2026

    We want to hear when something has gone wrong, and we will take it seriously.

    How to complain

    1. Email hello@moolah.example with the word "Complaint" in the subject.
    2. Tell us what happened, when, and what you would like us to do.
    3. We will acknowledge your complaint within 2 business days.
    4. We will look into it and tell you the outcome and our reasons in writing.

    If you are not satisfied

    • Privacy complaints can go to the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner at oaic.gov.au.
    • Consumer complaints can go to NSW Fair Trading at fairtrading.nsw.gov.au or the Australian Competition and Consumer Commission at accc.gov.au.

    If Moolah offers a regulated financial service, we will join the external dispute resolution scheme the law requires and say so on this page.

    Accessibility

    Last updated 2 October 2026

    We want Moolah to work for everyone, including people who use screen readers, keyboards or other assistive tools. Our target is WCAG 2.2 Level AA.

    What is in place

    • A "skip to content" link
    • Visible keyboard focus on links and buttons
    • Text labels for many controls and images
    • Some animations switch off when your device is set to reduce motion

    Known gaps

    • Not every moving element, such as the stock ticker, can yet be paused.
    • Colour contrast and screen reader labels have not been fully audited.

    We are working on these. If something does not work for you, tell us at hello@moolah.example and we will try to help or find another way.

    Privacy Policy

    Last updated 2 October 2026. Moolah is an early preview. We will update this policy before accounts or payments launch.

    1. Who we are

    Moolah, no ABN (this site is a demo), Sydney NSW, Australia ("Moolah", "we"). Contact: hello@moolah.example.

    2. What this covers

    This policy covers this website and the app preview. We follow the Australian Privacy Principles in the Privacy Act 1988 (Cth).

    3. What we collect

    • Information typed into the preview. A name, username and email on the sign-up screen, your progress, practice portfolio, outfit and settings. This is saved in your browser on your own device. It is not sent to us.
    • If you contact us. Your name, email address and message.
    • If you join a waitlist or mailing list. Your email address and a record of when and where you agreed.

    4. Why we collect it

    To run and improve Moolah, to reply to you and, if you agree, to tell you when Moolah launches.

    5. Who else may receive information

    • Google Fonts. When the page loads, your browser contacts Google to fetch fonts, so Google receives your IP address and browser details.
    • Finnhub. Only if you choose the optional live prices feature. Finnhub receives the stock symbols requested and the key you entered.
    • Our hosting provider. Standard server logs, such as IP address, may be kept by the host.
    • Email or form providers. If you contact us or join a list, the provider we use will handle that information for us.

    Some of these providers are overseas, including in the United States. We take reasonable steps to make sure they handle information in line with Australian privacy law.

    6. Children

    Moolah is designed for kids and adults. We collect as little as possible from children and encourage nicknames instead of real names. Before we add accounts for children, we will ask a parent or guardian for consent and update this policy.

    7. Security and retention

    We take reasonable steps to protect information we hold. We keep it only as long as we need it, then delete or de-identify it. Contact messages are kept only as long as needed to deal with your request. Waitlist details are kept until you unsubscribe.

    8. Your choices

    You can ask to see, correct or delete the information we hold about you by emailing us. You can clear what the preview stores on your device through your browser settings. You can unsubscribe from any marketing email at any time.

    9. Complaints

    Tell us first at hello@moolah.example. If you are not satisfied, you can complain to the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner at oaic.gov.au.

    10. Changes

    We may update this policy and will change the date above when we do.

    Disclaimer

    Last updated 2 October 2026

    Moolah provides general financial education, not financial advice.

    General information only

    Everything in Moolah is general information. It does not take into account your objectives, financial situation or needs. Before acting on anything, think about whether it suits you and consider speaking to a licensed financial adviser.

    Practice results are not real results

    Practice trades use pretend money. Results from practice trading or simulated prices do not predict what would happen with real money.

    About the prices

    Prices in Moolah are simulated. If you use the optional live feature, real percentage movements are applied to practice prices. They are not live quotes and may be delayed or wrong. Do not use them to make real decisions.

    Investing involves risk

    Real investing carries risk, including the loss of the money you invest.

    Company names and logos

    Company names and logos shown in Moolah belong to their owners. They appear only to help you learn what companies look like in the market. No affiliation or endorsement is suggested.

    Lessons are simplified

    Lessons are written to be easy to follow, so they leave out detail. They are a starting point, not a full guide.

    Cookies and Storage

    Last updated 2 October 2026

    Moolah does not set cookies.

    What is stored on your device

    The preview uses your browser's local storage to remember:

    • your progress, practice portfolio and activity;
    • your chosen outfit and profile picture for Moo;
    • profile details you typed in (name, username, email); and
    • a Finnhub key, only if you chose the optional live prices feature.

    This stays on your device. We do not receive it.

    Outside services

    Google Fonts receives your IP address when the page loads. Finnhub receives requests only if you use the live feature. See the Privacy Policy.

    How to clear it

    Open your browser settings and clear the site data for this website. If we add analytics or other trackers later, we will update this page first.
